slots.name: Pingree support
slots.sentence: The AARP poll also found Democratic candidate Hannah Pingree leading in the governor’s race in Maine. Fifty-two percent of respondents supported her, while 39 percent backed her Republican opponent, Robert Charles, and 6 percent backed Independent Rick Bennett.
